_about: Speaking voices (Kokoro TTS recipes). Jonny picked these by ear on 2026-10-25 from audio/voice-test-01; the other test voices were rejected as scary or bad, don't bring them back without asking him. A character uses one with "tts": "<name>"; a say or narrate line can pick another with "voice". voice = Kokoro voices to blend (weights), pitch in semitones. Recipes with "vox" (7 Nov 2026) are read by VoxCPM2 (vox.py) in the voice of vox.ref; their Kokoro voice, speed and lang only time the mouth and captions. vox.base is the character's acting direction, joined with the tone's (speech.mjs VOX_STYLES); a line can set its own "style", and "take": n for another reading.
